accounting.attack_storage_budget: one half of the declared scratchpad bytes
accounting.compact_entry_layout: 8-byte value plus 4-byte word index plus 4-byte generation or replacement metadata
accounting.conservative_entry_layout: 8-byte value plus 8-byte word/version identity plus 8-byte replacement metadata
accounting.unbudgeted_state: none within the simulated value cache; an executable attacker must also deduct control state, queues, allocator overhead, and checkpoints

policies.lru: online least-recently-used write-allocate cache over materialized scratch values
policies.offline_optimal: Belady-style oracle using the completed dynamic trace and discarding values with no future read before overwrite

why_not_decisive: cache misses do not recompute values or produce a valid proof
the offline optimal policy knows future value-dependent accesses that an online miner does not know
the simulated cache does not include executable control state, queues, stack, checkpoints, or allocator overhead
a full scratch snapshot cannot fit within the half-memory budget
